notes: Chandra's Embercat (M20): its {R} may be spent only to CAST an Elemental or Chandra planeswalker spell, never on an activated ability. Mana abilities are no menu rows (2026-11-11): a game activates one only while a cost is paid, the payer choosing the source and its colour (CR 605.3a), so the pack pays through a cast with "tap": true or the menu (act). With {W} besides, Pack Mastiff's {1}{R} ability cannot be paid, so the menu offers no row for it (no row at all: the window passes without an ask, and its word goes unused): nothing is spent and the Embercat stays untapped.
